data.narrative:
Lunar Outpost is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $23.6M to date. Valuation analysis relies on a peer universe of three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies (Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Starcloud at $1.1B Seed), alongside five public Space & Aerospace comps trading at a median P/S multiple of 24.4x.

Two methods triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression, applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A forward, yields $47M. Peer-median valuation across the three private comps produces $1.3B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to absence of revenue data for the target. These two methods generate a low bound of $40M, a median of $674M, and a high bound of $1.5B.

The wide range reflects material uncertainty around revenue trajectory and market position relative to peers. The stage-progression method implies modest early-stage valuation, while peer-median suggests substantially higher valuation if Lunar Outpost achieves comparable scale. Key uncertainties include revenue visibility, customer concentration, and regulatory pathway clarity. Further diligence on unit economics and customer acquisition would narrow the band.
